parts:
Hi all,

 

I’ve just started to use the reshape package, so apologies in advance for the somewhat newbie question.

 

I’m reading through the Reshaping Data with the reshape Package from the Journal of Statistical Software and am playing with the French fries data.  What I’m trying to do (on a real world data) is something like the table in Section 6.2 (Page 18) but in the form of (this example was done using Pivot Tables in Excel):

Cheers

Kev

I always forget how margins work :/ Maybe you need
dcast(ffm, treatment + rep + variable ~ ., sum, margins = c("treatment", "rep", "variable"))
acast returns a multidimensional array, dcast returns a data frame.
